reviewed.generatorDrift: the generator was edited during this review (mtime 17:20:28). Both versions carry the same logic for the two failing items: L182-183 still requires 0.05<t<0.95 and skips netflags, and L330-331 still call closeup-2 a text-vs-symbol confirmation. Only line numbers and an extra console line moved, so the findings below apply to the current generator too
reviewed.state: untracked at review time (git status ??), so this review is pinned to the guide hash above; the guide had not changed when this JSON was written, and a re-review is needed if it is regenerated

references.detail: the guide references 17 PNGs; 16 exist and their sha256 all match the r8t1 manifest (16/16), but the 17th - r9t1-main-overview.png, the guide's headline '一眼定位' image - does not exist
references.selfCheckGap: the guide says '文件核对：16 个引用文件，存在 16 个，sha256 一致 16 个'. That is true but incomplete: the generator's fileChecks loop only iterates manifest.tiles + manifest.closeups (16), so by construction it can never notice that the overview it links to was never written
references.related: its machine-readable companion r9t1-main-third-class.json is also absent, so the wrote=0 / candidate counts exist only as prose

coordinates.pageRanges: all 16 page ranges quoted in the guide (12 tiles + 4 closeups) match the r8t1 manifest exactly - 0 mismatches
coordinates.labelAlignment: not verifiable: the rXcY contact sheet that the claim refers to is the missing overview PNG
coordinates.contentAnnotation: the closeup-2 row says 't55 最近文字-符号 151 单位（text29 图号 / u7）'. u7 is at (620,290) but the crop is (480,95)-(700,189), so u7 is 100+ units outside the crop and cannot be what the image shows; text29 图号 (590,142) is inside

noExaggeration.detail: the guide states '文字-符号：已确认真实重叠——closeup-2 中 16pt 项目名 dsh-t19-real-ic-1792425596633 压到「图幅」标签上'. Both participants are text primitives: text31 (content dsh-t19-real-ic-1792425596633, FontSize 16, at 404,116) and text32 (content 图幅, FontSize 14, at 590,116). This is a text-vs-text overlap
noExaggeration.contradictsSource: r8t1's own doc §14.35.18 calls the same image '真实的文字-文字重叠'
noExaggeration.internalContradiction: the same guide's next line declares '文字-文字：已确认非重叠' from closeup-1, so class 1 is simultaneously confirmed non-overlapping and (misclassified) confirmed overlapping
noExaggeration.consequence: class 2 gains a 'confirmed' status from evidence that belongs to class 1; a reader would conclude symbol-vs-text collisions were proven, which the cited pixels do not show

thirdClassRecompute.statedRule: '导线线段到锚点的最短距离 <= 6 单位' for text and '<= 12 单位' for symbols (device anchors)
thirdClassRecompute.recomputeWithStatedRule: text anchors: 0 hits (nearest is 130 units, so the text half is clean). component anchors within 12 units: 14 hits - 13 netflags (all sit on wire ends, distance 0) plus layout:flag:_3V3:bus:240 (distance 0, t=1)
thirdClassRecompute.implementedRule: the generator additionally requires 0.05 < t < 0.95 (endpoint excluded) and skips ComponentType==='netflag'; with that filter the count is 0
thirdClassRecompute.whyItMatters: the documented criterion and the implemented criterion are not the same. Recomputing '按索引给的阈值' yields 14 hits, not '（无）'; the 0 result only reproduces with an exclusion the guide never states
thirdClassRecompute.fairness: excluding wire endpoints and netflags is semantically defensible (a wire terminating on a pin is a connection, not a crossing), but it is a rule change and must be written next to the threshold

zeroWriteAndScene.readBlock: the in-page READ script only uses getAll / getState_* / getCurrentSchematicPageInfo / getAllSchematicPagesInfo; no save/delete/create/modify/clear/openDocument
zeroWriteAndScene.zoom: the generator issues no zoom call (grep for zoomTo in the .mjs: none)

whatWouldMakeItSound: write r9t1-main-overview.png (or drop the link and the rXcY claim) and include it in the self-check count, so the index references nothing that does not exist
reclassify closeup-2 as text-vs-text (text31 vs text32) and correct the '文字-符号 已确认' line; if no symbol overlap has been confirmed, class 2 stays 'unjudged'
either state the endpoint/netflag exclusion in the guide next to the 12-unit threshold, or report the 14 anchor hits and explain why they are connections rather than crossings
